// NEGATIVE fixture — `||=` / `&&=` only where a lexer must not see it. Nothing may be reported.
// A line comment: state.retries ||= 0
/* A block comment: state.ready &&= true */
const SINGLE = 'state.retries ||= 0';
const DOUBLE = "state.ready &&= true";
const TEMPLATE = `write it out longhand, never state.retries ||= 0`;
const IN_REGEX = /(\|\||&&)=/;

export function mentionsLogicalAssign(source) {
  // This one is load-bearing: read as division rather than a regex, the body below lands in the
  // scanned code as the literal text `&&=` and the gate reports a violation that is not there.
  return /\|\|=|&&=/.test(source);
}

export function seed(state) {
  if (!state.retries) state.retries = 0;
  if (state.ready && state.open) state.ready = true;
  return state;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
